dict.string: Knode records the sound of your Mac, such as the other people on a call, only when you start recording a meeting. The audio is transcribed on this Mac and is never sent anywhere.
Knode reads the events of the calendars you choose, only after you connect the Calendar source to a space. It never changes your calendars, and the events stay on this Mac.
Knode records your microphone only when you start recording a meeting. The audio is transcribed on this Mac and is never sent anywhere.
